column1: # What the probe account answered on 2026-11-04 (run 1, spec h14b), line by line: the eleven rows measured on the emulator

# key's Azure answer is these lines read again through Calcite in process

# class passed 6 of its 7 rows: IntegralNumbersReadBackAsHeld failed, Azure holding 9007199254740993.0 as an int64 where the
# emulator holds it as a double. The string function class passed 4 of 4. 4,273.59 and 1,441.42 RU.
# Where Azure answered apart from EN20261019, 51 of 2,809 lines: 12 of the two-path row's, a string holding U+0000 against
# "bikes", which Azure orders by code point; one of the arithmetic row's, 9223372036854775807 % 2, 0 on Azure; one of the
